text:
- **Go pm only:** Python pm is deleted from both repos, so Go pm is the only implementation. Tracking for pm-harness moved to Yeeef/pm with its full history.
- **Release and CI:** The new pm release shows its changelog section as the release notes. PR checks run much faster, and CI refuses changes without a changelog entry.
- **Site reading:** Wide Mermaid diagrams scroll sideways on phones and redraw after a theme switch. The site no longer shows errors in place of pages while git rewrites records.
- **Owner requests:** Agents now act on a step themselves before they ask the owner. A request with no sprint or task gets one opened first.
